Energizer®introduces Energi To Go® instant Cell Phone Charger.


Energizer® introduces the Weather Ready® line of lighting products.


2006


Energizer® introduces Energi To Go® Portable Power for the iPod®.


Energizer® introduces a new line of Energizer e2® Lithium® flashlights for the extreme outdoor enthusiast.


2007


Energizer® partners with Phillips and Techtium to introduce first-ever mobile phone to have a battery back-up with a single AAA battery.
